L3~L4 口說練習句

第 1 題（1/20）
提示：時間動詞變化補字（留空）｜答案：紅色粗體底線＝提示字沒有或有變化的字　鍵盤：← →
1
When people / see the baseball player yesterday / shout his name
When people saw the baseball player yesterday, they shouted his name.
2
When Jay / have time / go to the movies with his friend
現在式When Jay has time, he goes to the movies with his friend.
過去式When Jay had time, he went to the movies with his friend.
3
Lucy / be happy / when / find her dog last week
Lucy was happy when she found her dog last week.
4
When Henry / visit the temple last Sunday / ask many questions
When Henry visited the temple last Sunday, he asked many questions.
5
Ella's parents / be proud of her / when / win the badminton game this afternoon
Ella's parents were proud of her when she won the badminton game this afternoon.
6
It was five ____ in the morning.
Jack / listen to his teacher / in class
It was five to ten in the morning. Jack was listening to his teacher in class.
7
It was half ____.
Jack / have lunch / in the classroom
It was half past twelve. Jack was having lunch in the classroom.
8
It was a ____ in the afternoon.
Jack / play basketball
It was a quarter to five in the afternoon. Jack was playing basketball.
9
It was ten ____ in the evening.
Jack / take a shower / in the bathroom
It was ten to nine in the evening. Jack was taking a shower in the bathroom.
10
Now, it is a ____ in the evening.
Jack / sleep
Now, it is a quarter past / after ten in the evening. Jack is sleeping.
11
I want / buy a camera
I want to buy a camera.
12
The waiter / need / work on Sundays
The waiter needs to work on Sundays.
13
Anna / learn / be a reporter / when / twenty
Anna learned to be a reporter when she was twenty.
14
Lily / plan / write a story about a police officer
Lily plans / planned to write a story about a police officer.
15
Jeff / want / have some ice cream
Jeff wants to have some ice cream.
16
The girl / enjoy / watch movies
The girl enjoys watching movies.
17
Brian / practice / swim every morning
Brian practices swimming every morning.
18
Joyce / keep / talk with Sally in class yesterday
Joyce kept talking with Sally in class yesterday.
19
Mr. Jones / enjoy / cook for his children
Mr. Jones enjoys cooking for his children.
20
John / finish / read the storybook
John finished reading the storybook.
